claims: A Tyndalston Story is a single-player open-world action-adventure game.
A Tyndalston Story was released on April 8, 2026, for PC (Steam/Epic).
A Tyndalston Story was developed by Liquid Swords.
A Tyndalston Story was led by a Just Cause co-creator.
A Tyndalston Story is set in a '90s-inspired city.
A Tyndalston Story, players can use the environment for combat.
A Tyndalston Story, players can break objects to use as weapons.
A Tyndalston Story, players can launch objects at enemies.
A Tyndalston Story features a "Daily Quota" system.
A Tyndalston Story features an "Action Point" system.
A Tyndalston Story, players manage debt by selecting missions.
A Tyndalston Story, players take the role of Samson McCray.
Samson McCray is forced to return to the city of Tyndalston.
Samson McCray fights to pay off debt while protecting his sister.
A Tyndalston Story is built on Unreal Engine 5.
Console ports for Xbox Series X|S and PS5 are planned for Samson: A Tyndalston Story after the PC launch.
